# Source Analysis

The Set Points calculator requires the Validation Set Points module. Without it, you can manually enter validation parameters in the Source Editor for each source.

FLOWCAL uses built-in validation set points to identify data anomalies. These set points are based on limits imposed by various calculation standards. They can also be added to meters and quality sources to flag data that is outside of normal operating boundaries.

Set points can be calculated for multiple sources at a time using the Validation Set Points calculator for Source Analysis, based on each source’s historical data. Validation set points are determined based on data in a specified date range and the percentage of data to be flagged. To ensure that valid set points are calculated, this should only be used once data has been reviewed and verified.

Validation set points are logged to the Validation History if the "Log Validation Set Points History" option is enabled in FLOWCAL Configuration. To view the set point history, open the Source Editor, select the Validations tab, and click Show History.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Source Analysis Set Point Calculator:

Go to **Review** \> **Set Points** \> **Source Analysis**.

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Validation Set Points Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Validation Set Points screen:

- **Source/Source List** - Select whether to analyze data for a source or a list of sources.

- **Analyze From/To** - Specify a date range of data to analyze.

- **Percent Flagged** - This field establishes where the set points will be calculated relative to the data used. The percentage of data to be flagged is defaulted to 0.001%, which means that based on historical data, 0.001% of the user's data should be flagged with an exception in the future.

  The closer this value is to zero, the closer the set points will be to the minimum and maximum data values for each parameter. When setting these set points for the first time, it is recommended that you use .001%, so that you are not overwhelmed with exceptions.

- **Override Pre-Existing Values** - If this option is checked, the value calculated for the set point will be used in place of previously calculated values. If the option is not checked, values that were previously calculated or manually entered will not be overwritten.

- **Run on Imports and Edits** - Check this option to activate the set points.

- **Run Min/Run Max** - For each parameter, select whether to calculate the minimum or maximum values.

- **Clear All** - Uncheck all parameters on the selected tab.

- **Check All** - Check all parameters on the selected tab.

- **Run** - Calculate and save the set points for every meter in the list, location, or close group. Go to the Validations tab in the Meter Editor to view the calculated set points.

</div>
